system.description:
Ketsuki stands in the middle of the arena, his rival standing opposite to him. “How are you still standing? I've closed so many of your Chakra points. Just fall over and give up already Ketsuki!” his rival cried out. Ketsuki, stumbling but resisting to fall over, begins to weave hand seals. “I don’t back down! You of all people should know that by now!” he screams as he finishes his hand seals and creates a wave of Fire from the ground as it rolls towards his rival, overcoming him and defeating him as the crowds from the chunin arena screams in excitement.

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 6 excerpt.

Never Backing Down

The Uzumaki Clan was formerly a prominent clan in the whirlpool country. Since its destruction, most of its members have resided in Konoha. Despite its past demise, over 100 years after the Fourth Shinobi World War the clan is once again active and prominent in the land of Fire. Uzumaki's skill with Fuinjutsu earned them both respect and fear throughout the ninja world. Uzumaki naturally possess incredibly strong life-forces. As such, they have very long lifespans and likewise age slower.

Uzumaki Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Cha

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, Ninshou

Uzumaki Sealing Techniques: The Uzumaki have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list.

Hijutsu Flexibility: Uzumaki Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Overwhelming Determination: Jutsu you create using the Creating a Jutsu rules (See Chapter 7: Adventuring & Missions, Learning/Creating A Jutsu) increases the maximum number of effects they can have by +1.

Uzumaki Features

Wellspring of Chakra

1st Level Clan Feature

The Uzumaki’s are known for their unmatched stamina and chakra reserves. Increase your Chakra point total by 2. Every level thereafter, increase your chakra point total by 2.

Additionally, this reserve of chakra stabilizes within you as pockets of self-energizing stores of chakra. This reserve of Chakra can be call upon and is known as Spiral Cells, of which you have 2. Once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, while you are not incapacitated or have ranks of Sealed you can call on this energy and spend 1 Spiral Cell. When you do, you gain 4 Temporary Chakra points. You regain spent Spiral Cells when you complete a rest.

Beginning at 7th level, increase the total number of Spiral Cells you have to 4. Also, when you would take chakra damage or gain ranks of a Mental or Sensory condition you can spend 1 Spiral Cell to reduce the damage taken by an amount equal to your level or ranks of the condition gained to 0.

Beginning at 11th level, increase the Temporary Chakra points gained to 6.

Beginning at 15th level, increase the total number of Spiral Cells you have to 6.

Binding Chains

1st Level Clan Feature

The blood of the Uzumaki has crystalized and come to bear within you. You can manifest Chains of Binding. A special technique born of special fuinjutsu techniques inherent to your bloodline. These Chains of Binding manifest themselves as chakra-based chains of your description, manifesting themselves from your chakra core, but protruding from your body in a way you describe (from your back, your arms, belly, shoulders, etc.).

As a bonus action you can manifest these chains for 1 minute, by entering your Binding Chain chakra stance. Unlike other chakra stances, you can benefit from this chakra stance and either a Taijutsu stance or a Bukijutsu stance, at the same time.

When you enter this stance, you gain the following benefits;

You gain the Seal Break benefit from Uzumaki clan Hijutsu you cast.

When you take the attack action, you can choose to instead make either a Binding Chain or Striking Chain attack. These attacks use you’re your highest jutsu attack bonus.

Binding Chain. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack against a creature you can see, as your chains encircle them. On a hit, you deal half the listed damage and once per turn, make an affected creature make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, being Sealed on a failure. Beginning at 7th level, you can increase the number of creatures you can target with this attack to 2. Beginning at 15th level, this increases to 3.

Striking Chain. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack against a creature you can see, as your chains strike out, dealing the listed melee or ranged damage on a hit. You can replace up to two attacks you would make as part of the Attack action with this attack. Beginning at 7th level, attacks against a Grappled or Prone creature is always at advantage. Beginning at 15th level, you can pick one physical damage type, in addition to chakra damage dealing both at the same time.

Melee: 1d8 + your Jutsu ability modifier in Bludgeoning, Piercing or Chakra damage. This increases to 2d8 + your Jutsu ability modifier at 11th level.

Ranged: 30 feet, 1d8 Bludgeoning, Piercing or Chakra damage. This increases to 2d8 at 11th level.

Swirling Seals

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your binding chains aren’t the only secret technique passed down through the Uzumaki clan. You also learn to prepare special sealing formulas known only to your clan. These formulas are places onto chakra seals, turning them into Spiral Tags. Spiral Tags are special tags that can apply to damage dealt with the Binding Chain clan feature, as part of casting an Uzumaki Hijutsu or even following its effect text.

You can use no more than one Spiral Tags per turn. You begin with 2 known Spiral Tags. You gain an additional one at 7th and 11th levels. A Spiral Tag that requires a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC. If you would use a Spiral Tag that requires a saving throw as part of a Hijutsu you cast that also forces a saving throw, you pick which saving throw to use, following both effects on a success or failure.

Bound Inscription. As part of damage dealt or a creature failing a saving throw you can affix a Spiral Tag to the affected creature for the next minute. Alternatively, as a Bonus action, you can affix it to a willing creature, object or surface, which lasts for 24 hours. While affixed, and you are within at least 1 mile of the Spiral Tag, you can sense and hear creatures within 15 feet of the affixed location, enough to target them as if you could see them. You can make Binding Chain attacks or cast Uzumaki Hijutsu, having them originate from the tags affixed location.

Barrier Reverse Technique. As part of damage dealt with an attack granted by the Binding Chain feature, against a creature with ranks of Sealed, you can have the binding formula overwritten. Affected creatures with ranks of sealed must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the Sealed condition gains an additional effect for the next minute; A Sealed creature suffers a -1 penalty to their AC for every rank they have, but they lose one rank of sealed at the end of each of their turns.

Sealing Cage. As an Action, you can select one creature you can see, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw as they are enveloped by chains of binding, like a globe or orb. On a failed save, they are captured inside of the dome until the end of your next turn. While inside the globe they are under total cover, and blinded. They cannot be targeted or affected by hostile effects and cannot take hostile action. While within the dome they cannot mold chakra. By spending a Full-Turn Action, you can extend the duration until the end of your following turn. A creature trapped inside this dome can escape by spending their Action, making a Strength saving throw, shattering the dome on a success.

Draining Seals. As part of making an attack granted by the Binding Chain feature, or casting an Uzumaki Hijutsu that deals damage, you can force the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Weakened on a failed save. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.

Warding Seal. As a bonus action, you can mark a willing creature other than yourself, that you can see within 30 feet of you with a ward. A creature marked with this ward gains a rank of Mastery to their AC and a +1 bonus to their saving throws. While you have a creature marked in this way, this counts as concentrating on a jutsu of C-Rank.

Rebuking Seal. As part of making an attack granted by the Binding Chain feature, or casting an Uzumaki Hijutsu that deals damage, you can force an affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, they gain a rank of Concussed on a failed save. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.

Gut Feeling

7th Level Clan Feature

Your clans instincts are legendary. So much so that this gut feeling is almost like a second bloodline trait. Your intuition sharpens your reactions and your read on people and your sense for traps.

While conscious, you cannot be surprised by hidden creatures. If one or more of your allies are surprised, you gain a rank of Mastery to your initiative, for each surprised allied creature.

Additionally, when a creature makes a Deception check against you, your GM treats your passive Insight as +5 higher.

If you would attempt the See through lies skill action, you make the check using either Constitution or Charisma. If you would beat the contested check by 5 or more, you gain a Will of Fire. You can gain a Will of Fire in this way, once per long rest.

Warding Network

11th Level Clan Feature

You sketch binding seals into the air, creating ninjutsu like effects without weaving a single hand sign.

Once per turn, as a bonus action or as part of casting an Jutsu with the Fuinjutsu keyword, you can manifest a Spiral Ward at a point you can see within 60 feet of you. This ward looks like a piece of paper with a special sealing formula only possible via Uzumaki clan techniques. You can maintain up to 2 wards at once, and a creature can only ever benefit from one ward at a time, choosing which ward they want to benefit from if ever in 2 auras at once. You select which type of ward you want to apply from those listed at the end of this feature.

You count as maintaining concentration on a Ninjutsu of B-Rank, no matter how many wards you have active. Wards last until dispelled or you end concentration on them. Each ward emanates a 10-foot radius aura, centered on the point it occupies;

Aegis: All allied creatures in the affected area gain a rank of mastery to their AC.

Clarity: All allied creatures in the affected area gain a rank of mastery to their first saving throw they make per round.

Anchor: Hostile creatures that would teleport while within 1-mile of this anchor, must make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, teleporting into a space within the affected area on a failure.

Spiraling Chains

15th Level Clan Feature

You bind battlefields onto you. A living sigil of control or domination. The arena is yours to command.

As a Bonus Action, you can place a binding seal onto yourself, and the ground, at a point you can reach, which remains for the next minute. The sigil, releases a 120-foot radius aura centered on the point. The edges of the aura has binding chains at its perimeter.

For the duration, attacks made with the Binding Chain feature or jutsu you cast with the Fuinjutsu keyword, can target any creature within this radius, even if you cannot see them, so long as you are aware of them and they are within the radius, they can be targeted, even if behind full cover.

Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.
